name: Fiachra MacFadden
bio: Fiachra (Fiki) MacFadden is a Product Designer at a stealth-mode startup, designing AI-powered property related applications. On evenings and weekends, he’s designing, developing and distributing Zhiyin, an iOS app that helps users learn Mandarin through music. As a non-technical designer, Fiachra leverages AI tools like Claude Code to build this application. He has built this app in public, filming videos every day on his progress and learnings. The app accumulated over 4 million views on TikTok, led to over 1,300 TestFlight users, and officially launched on the App Store in early January 2026.
